scope: West Texas (Midland, Ector, Tom Green, Taylor counties) - basic needs

records.name: West Texas Food Bank - Partner Pantries and Mobile Distributions
records.description_en: The food bank gives free food through more than 100 partner pantries and weekly mobile food distributions across 19 West Texas counties, including Midland and Ector.
records.description_es: El banco de comida da comida gratis por medio de más de 100 despensas aliadas y repartos móviles cada semana en 19 condados del oeste de Texas, incluyendo Midland y Ector.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people and families in the food bank's service area who need food. Call to find the partner pantry or mobile distribution closest to you.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias en el área del banco de comida que necesitan alimentos. Llame para encontrar la despensa aliada o el reparto móvil más cercano.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Odessa or Midland office, or check the monthly mobile distribution schedule on the website, to find a pantry or mobile distribution near you. After hours, dial 2-1-1.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de Odessa o de Midland, o revise en la página web el calendario mensual de repartos móviles, para encontrar comida cerca de usted. Fuera de horario, marque 2-1-1.
records.notes: Midland location: 1601 Westcliff Drive, Midland, TX 79703, (432) 697-4003. The food bank ended in-house pantry distributions at its own buildings starting January 1, 2026; send clients to partner agencies and mobile distributions instead. Serves 19 counties total.

records.name: Senior Box Program (CSFP)
records.description_en: Income-eligible seniors can get a free box of food each month to help stretch their groceries. The food bank gives out about 2,000 senior boxes each month across its 19 counties.
records.description_es: Las personas mayores con ingresos bajos pueden recibir una caja de comida gratis cada mes para que les rinda más el mandado. El banco de comida reparte unas 2,000 cajas al mes en sus 19 condados.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income seniors age 60 and older in the food bank's 19-county service area, including Midland and Ector counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas mayores de 60 años o más con ingresos bajos que viven en los 19 condados del banco de comida, incluyendo Midland y Ector.
records.how_to_apply: Call the food bank in Odessa or Midland to ask about signing up for a senior box.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al banco de comida en Odessa o en Midland para preguntar cómo inscribirse para recibir la caja.
records.notes: USDA Commodity Supplemental Food Program. Midland office: (432) 697-4003. The food bank's page does not list age, income limits, or documents; age 60+ is the federal CSFP rule. Ask when calling.

records.name: San Angelo Food Bank - Recurring Food Distributions
records.organization: San Antonio Food Bank (San Angelo Food Bank branch)
records.description_en: The San Angelo Food Bank hands out free food at regular distributions in Tom Green and nearby counties. In San Angelo, distributions are held at Immanuel Baptist Church and at San Angelo Stadium.
records.description_es: El Banco de Comida de San Angelo reparte comida gratis en fechas fijas en Tom Green y condados cercanos. En San Angelo, los repartos son en la Iglesia Bautista Immanuel y en el San Angelo Stadium.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people and families in Tom Green, Irion, Sterling, Concho, and Coke counties who need food.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias de los condados de Tom Green, Irion, Sterling, Concho y Coke que necesitan comida.
records.how_to_apply: Go to a scheduled distribution. In San Angelo: Immanuel Baptist Church (90 E 14th Street) from 10 AM to 11 AM, or San Angelo Stadium (Johnson St. side) from 11 AM to 1 PM, on the listed dates. Check the website for current dates.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a un reparto en las fechas indicadas. En San Angelo: Iglesia Bautista Immanuel (90 E 14th Street) de 10 a 11 de la mañana, o San Angelo Stadium (lado de Johnson St.) de 11 de la mañana a 1 de la tarde. Revise la página web para ver las fechas actuales.
records.hours: Immanuel Baptist Church: 10 AM - 11 AM on Oct 15, Nov 19, and Dec 17, 2026. San Angelo Stadium (Johnson St. side): 11 AM - 1 PM on Sept 30, Oct 28, Nov 26, and Dec 23, 2026.
records.notes: Branch of the San Antonio Food Bank. Distributions are open to all in need. Other distributions are held in Coke, Irion, and Sterling counties. Address shown is the Immanuel Baptist Church distribution site, not an office. Phone is the food bank's main/benefits line.

records.name: Benefits Assistance (SNAP and other benefits application help)
records.organization: San Antonio Food Bank (San Angelo Food Bank branch)
records.description_en: Staff can help you apply for benefits like SNAP food benefits over the phone.
records.description_es: El personal le puede ayudar por teléfono a solicitar beneficios como SNAP (estampillas de comida).
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Concho Valley (Tom Green, Irion, Sterling, Concho, and Coke counties) who want help applying for benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del Concho Valley (condados de Tom Green, Irion, Sterling, Concho y Coke) que quieren ayuda para solicitar beneficios.
records.how_to_apply: Call the benefits assistance line during open hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda con beneficios en su horario de atención.
records.hours: Monday - Friday, 8 AM - 6 PM, and Saturday, 9 AM - 3 PM

records.name: Drive-Thru Pantry
records.organization: Food Bank of West Central Texas
records.description_en: You can drive up to the food bank in Abilene and get free food three times a month.
records.description_es: Puede llegar en carro al banco de comida en Abilene y recibir comida gratis tres veces al mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the food bank's service area who need food. The food bank serves Taylor County and eight nearby counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el área del banco de comida que necesitan alimentos. El banco atiende el condado de Taylor y ocho condados cercanos.
records.how_to_apply: Drive to the food bank at the scheduled times. Call ahead if you have questions about what to bring.
records.how_to_apply_es: Maneje hasta el banco de comida en los horarios indicados. Si tiene preguntas sobre qué llevar, llame antes.
records.hours: 1st Thursday 9-10:30 AM; 2nd Saturday 9-10:30 AM; 3rd Monday 4:30-6 PM
records.notes: The 1st Thursday distribution is also Senior Resource Day. Eligibility and document requirements are not listed on the website; call or email info@fbwct.org.

records.name: Food Pantry Locator, Mobile Pantries, and SNAP Help
records.organization: Food Bank of West Central Texas
records.description_en: The food bank has a map of local food pantries, mobile food pantries, and meal sites, and it can help you apply for SNAP food benefits.
records.description_es: El banco de comida tiene un mapa de despensas locales, despensas móviles y lugares donde dan comidas, y le puede ayudar a solicitar SNAP (estampillas de comida).
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Callahan, Coleman, Comanche, Eastland, Fisher, Nolan, Runnels, Stephens, and Taylor counties who need food.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de los condados de Callahan, Coleman, Comanche, Eastland, Fisher, Nolan, Runnels, Stephens y Taylor que necesitan comida.
records.how_to_apply: Use the online map or download the Taylor County pantry schedule to find food near you. Call the food bank for help applying for SNAP.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el mapa en internet o descargue el calendario de despensas del condado de Taylor para encontrar comida cerca de usted. Llame al banco de comida si quiere ayuda para solicitar SNAP.

records.name: Rust Street Ministries Food and Clothing Help
records.description_en: This ministry in San Angelo gives out groceries and clothing.
records.description_es: Este ministerio en San Angelo reparte víveres y ropa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in San Angelo who need food or clothing.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en San Angelo que necesitan comida o ropa.
records.how_to_apply: Visit during open hours for groceries; no appointment is needed. Clothing is by appointment only; call first.
records.how_to_apply_es: Para víveres, venga en el horario de atención; no necesita cita. La ropa es solo con cita; llame primero.
records.hours: Monday - Thursday 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., Friday 9:00 a.m. to noon
records.notes: Site says current operations are limited to clothing (by appointment only) and groceries due to increased demand.

records.name: Midland Soup Kitchen Ministry Daily Meals
records.description_en: This ministry serves about 150 free home-cooked meals every day in Midland and gives free clothing, no questions asked.
records.description_es: Este ministerio sirve unas 150 comidas caseras gratis todos los días en Midland y regala ropa sin hacer preguntas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone in Midland who needs a meal.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para cualquier persona en Midland que necesite una comida.
records.how_to_apply: Contact the ministry by email or social media to confirm meal times and location.
records.how_to_apply_es: Escriba al ministerio por correo electrónico o redes sociales para confirmar el horario y el lugar de las comidas.
records.notes: Website did not list an address, phone, or meal times. Contact: info@midlandsoupkitchen.org.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) Utility Assistance
records.description_en: This program helps low-income households pay electric, gas, and propane bills. It also teaches ways to save energy.
records.description_es: Este programa ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar la luz, el gas y el propano. También enseña formas de ahorrar energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households in Tom Green and 10 other Concho Valley counties with income under the limit (2026: $23,940 for 1 person, $32,460 for 2, $40,980 for 3, $49,500 for 4; add $8,520 for each extra person).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares en Tom Green y otros 10 condados del Concho Valley con ingresos por debajo del límite (2026: $23,940 para 1 persona, $32,460 para 2, $40,980 para 3, $49,500 para 4; sume $8,520 por cada persona más).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of Coke, Concho, Crockett, Irion, Kimble, Menard, Reagan, Schleicher, Sterling, Sutton, or Tom Green County

documents_needed: Required documentation listed on the agency's forms page
records.how_to_apply: Get the application and document list from the agency's forms page, then turn it in with your documents. Inside San Angelo city limits you must apply during application windows (25 in-person applications taken each day); outside the city you can apply any time during business hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pida la solicitud y la lista de documentos en la página de formularios de la agencia, y entréguela con sus papeles. Si vive dentro de la ciudad de San Angelo, debe aplicar en las fechas de solicitud (se reciben 25 solicitudes en persona al día); si vive fuera de la ciudad, puede aplicar cualquier día en horario de oficina.
records.hours: Mon - Thur 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.; closed to the public Fri - Sun
records.notes: Processing takes 60-90 days before a pledge is made to the utility account, so this is not for same-day shutoff emergencies. Toll free: 1-877-41-CVCAA. The CEAP provider for Tom Green County.

records.name: Tenant-Based Rental Assistance (TBRA)
records.description_en: This program helps pay rent for up to 24 months and can help with a security deposit while you work toward being self-sufficient.
records.description_es: Este programa ayuda a pagar la renta hasta por 24 meses y puede ayudar con el depósito, mientras usted trabaja para salir adelante por su cuenta.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households with income at or below 80% of Area Median Income who live in Tom Green or another Concho Valley county outside San Angelo city limits, have some income, are not behind on past rent, and agree to a self-sufficiency plan.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos de 80% o menos del ingreso medio del área, que viven en Tom Green u otro condado del Concho Valley fuera de la ciudad de San Angelo, que tienen algún ingreso, que no deben renta atrasada y que aceptan un plan para ser autosuficientes.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Concho Valley county resident living OUTSIDE San Angelo city limits

documents_needed: Application documents (submit by email, phone, mail, or fax)
records.how_to_apply: Contact the agency by phone or email, or mail/fax documents to the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con la agencia por teléfono o correo electrónico, o mande sus documentos por correo o fax a la oficina.
records.hours: Mon - Thur 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
records.notes: Not available to people living inside San Angelo city limits. Email: housing@cvcaa.org. Income limit charts by county are on the page (updated June 1, 2026). Closed Fri - Sun.

records.name: Free Tax Assistance (VITA)
records.description_en: IRS-certified volunteers prepare and e-file your taxes for free, so you can get your refund and tax credits.
records.description_es: Voluntarios certificados por el IRS preparan y mandan sus impuestos por internet gratis, para que reciba su reembolso y sus créditos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low- and moderate-income individuals and families.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias de ingresos bajos y moderados.
documents_needed: Valid picture ID for all filers
Social Security cards for everyone on the return
Form 1095-A if you have Marketplace insurance
Last year's tax return if available
Bank routing and account numbers for direct deposit
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment. Married couples filing jointly must both come.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita. Si es pareja casada que declara junta, los dos deben venir.
records.hours: January 15 through April 15 each year, by appointment
records.notes: Seasonal program; appointments required.

records.name: PermiaCare Behavioral Health and IDD Services (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: PermiaCare gives mental health, substance use, intellectual and developmental disability (IDD), HIV, and early childhood intervention services. It runs a 24-hour crisis line.
records.description_es: PermiaCare da servicios de salud mental, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, servicios para discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo (IDD), intervención temprana para niños pequeños y servicios para veteranos. Tiene una línea de crisis abierta las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Midland, Ector, and six other West Texas counties who need mental health, substance use, or disability services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Midland, Ector y otros seis condados del oeste de Texas que necesitan servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour line at 1-844-420-3964 for crisis help or to start behavioral health services. For IDD services in Midland call (432) 570-3385.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de 24 horas al 1-844-420-3964 si está en crisis o para empezar servicios de salud mental. Para servicios de IDD en Midland, llame al (432) 570-3385.
records.hours: Crisis line open 24 hours
records.notes: Local Mental Health Authority for Midland, Ector, Brewster, Pecos, Culberson, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, and Presidio counties. IDD: (432) 570-3385 (Midland) or 1-844-420-3966 toll-free. Also offers veteran services. In a life-threatening emergency call 911; 988 is also available.

records.name: Betty Hardwick Center (Local Mental Health and IDD Authority)
records.description_en: The Betty Hardwick Center gives mental health care for adults and children, substance use treatment, disability (IDD) services, early childhood intervention, and veteran services, plus a 24-hour crisis line.
records.description_es: El Betty Hardwick Center da atención de salud mental para adultos y niños, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, servicios para discapacidades (IDD), intervención temprana para niños pequeños y servicios para veteranos, además de una línea de crisis de 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Taylor, Callahan, Jones, Shackelford, and Stephens counties who need mental health, substance use, or disability services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los condados de Taylor, Callahan, Jones, Shackelford y Stephens que necesitan servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main office to ask about services, or call the 24-hour crisis line for crisis help, information, and referrals.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina principal para preguntar por los servicios, o llame a la línea de crisis de 24 horas si necesita ayuda urgente, información o referencias.
records.notes: 24-hour crisis hotline: (800) 758-3344. For emergencies call 911.

records.name: MHMR Concho Valley (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: MHMR Concho Valley gives crisis services, mental health care, substance use treatment, disability (IDD) services, veteran services, and housing and job help.
records.description_es: MHMR Concho Valley da servicios de crisis, atención de salud mental, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, servicios para discapacidades (IDD), servicios para veteranos y ayuda con vivienda y empleo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in San Angelo and the Concho Valley who need mental health, substance use, or disability services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en San Angelo y el Concho Valley que necesitan servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number during business hours to start services, or call the crisis line any time.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal en horario de oficina para empezar servicios, o llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora.
records.hours: 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM, 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM (crisis line 24/7)
records.notes: Crisis line: (800) 375-8965 or (325) 653-5933. Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic. The City of San Angelo says its HOME program temporary tenant-based rental assistance is provided through MHMR.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Permian Basin - Midland and Odessa Workforce Centers
records.description_en: Workforce centers help you look for a job, go to job fairs, and get training. They also run the child care assistance program for the area.
records.description_es: Los centros de empleo le ayudan a buscar trabajo, ir a ferias de empleo y recibir capacitación. También manejan el programa de ayuda para el cuidado de niños en la región.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the Permian Basin, including Midland and Ector counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en la Cuenca Pérmica, incluyendo los condados de Midland y Ector.
records.how_to_apply: Visit or call the Midland or Odessa workforce center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite o llame al centro de empleo de Midland o de Odessa.
records.address: 3600 N. Garfield, Midland College Technology Center Room 138
records.notes: Odessa center: 2626 JBS Parkway, Bldg. D, Odessa, TX 79761, (432) 367-3332. Toll free 1-800-248-6451. Hours not listed online; call first.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Scholarships)
records.description_en: This program helps working families, students, and people in training pay for child care.
records.description_es: Este programa ayuda a familias que trabajan, estudian o están en capacitación a pagar el cuidado de sus niños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families in the Permian Basin with children under 13 (under 19 if disabled) who work, go to school, or train at least 25 hours a week (50 combined for two parents). Income must be at or below 85% of State Median Income (family of 4: $95,403 a year).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de la Cuenca Pérmica con niños menores de 13 años (menores de 19 si tienen una discapacidad) que trabajan, estudian o se capacitan por lo menos 25 horas a la semana (50 horas entre los dos padres). Los ingresos deben ser de 85% o menos del ingreso medio del estado (familia de 4: $95,403 al año).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Permian Basin workforce area resident (includes Midland and Ector counties)

records.how_to_apply: Create an account in TX3C at childcare.texas.gov and apply online. Call Child Care Services with questions.
records.how_to_apply_es: Cree una cuenta en TX3C en childcare.texas.gov y aplique por internet. Si tiene preguntas, llame a Servicios de Cuidado Infantil.
records.hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
records.cost: Parent share of cost based on income
records.notes: Waitlist in effect since July 7, 2026; waits may be 3 to 6 months. Job-search child care is available for a limited time (must find work within 90 days). max_age 12 applies unless the child has a disability (then under 19).

records.name: Workforce Solutions of the Concho Valley - San Angelo Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions of the Concho Valley
records.description_en: The workforce center helps with job search, resumes, skills tests, job training, GED and adult education, vocational rehabilitation, and veteran job services.
records.description_es: El centro de empleo ayuda con la búsqueda de trabajo, currículums, pruebas de habilidades, capacitación, GED y educación para adultos, rehabilitación vocacional y servicios de empleo para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the 13-county Concho Valley region, including Tom Green County. Veterans get priority of service.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en los 13 condados del Concho Valley, incluyendo el condado de Tom Green. Los veteranos tienen prioridad.
records.how_to_apply: Visit or call the San Angelo workforce center. You can also search jobs on WorkInTexas.com.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite o llame al centro de empleo de San Angelo. También puede buscar trabajos en WorkInTexas.com.
records.notes: Toll free: (800) 996-7589. Also runs TANF Choices and SNAP E&T employment programs. Hours not listed on the contact page.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Scholarships)
records.organization: Workforce Solutions of the Concho Valley
records.description_en: This program helps eligible families pay for child care so parents can work, look for work, or go to school.
records.description_es: Este programa ayuda a familias que califican a pagar el cuidado de sus niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, buscar trabajo o estudiar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families in Tom Green and 12 other Concho Valley counties. Single parents must work or study at least 25 hours a week (50 combined for two parents). Gross monthly income limits: $3,988 (1), $5,216 (2), $6,443 (3), $7,670 (4), $8,897 (5).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias en Tom Green y otros 12 condados del Concho Valley. Si hay un solo padre, debe trabajar o estudiar por lo menos 25 horas a la semana (50 horas entre los dos padres). Límite de ingreso mensual bruto: $3,988 (1), $5,216 (2), $6,443 (3), $7,670 (4), $8,897 (5).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of Tom Green, Concho, Coke, Irion, Kimble, Mason, McCulloch, Menard, Reagan, Schleicher, Sterling, Sutton, or Crockett County

records.how_to_apply: Apply online through cvworkforce.org or childcare.texas.gov, or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique por internet en cvworkforce.org o childcare.texas.gov, o llame por teléfono.
records.cost: Parent share of cost based on income
records.notes: Waiting list in effect; delays may be 6 weeks or more. Family assets cannot exceed $1 million. Each child must be a U.S. citizen or have legal immigration status. Full-time students are limited to 60 months unless also working. Families without a permanent home may qualify. Toll free (800) 996-7589.

records.name: Workforce Solutions of West Central Texas - Abilene Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions of West Central Texas
records.description_en: The workforce center helps with job placement, hiring events, career pathways, and skill-building workshops.
records.description_es: El centro de empleo ayuda a encontrar trabajo, con eventos de contratación, planes de carrera y talleres para aprender nuevas habilidades.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in West Central Texas, including Taylor County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en el centro-oeste de Texas, incluyendo el condado de Taylor.
records.how_to_apply: Visit or call the Abilene workforce center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite o llame al centro de empleo de Abilene.
records.hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm
records.notes: Toll free (800) 457-5633. Relay: (800) 735-2989 (TTY) / 711 (Voice). Language assistance and accessibility accommodations are free.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Scholarships)
records.organization: Workforce Solutions of West Central Texas
records.description_en: This program helps eligible families pay for child care while they work, go to school, train, or look for a job.
records.description_es: Este programa ayuda a familias que califican a pagar el cuidado de sus niños mientras trabajan, estudian, se capacitan o buscan trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families in West Central Texas, including Taylor County, who meet federal, state, and local guidelines.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias del centro-oeste de Texas, incluyendo el condado de Taylor, que cumplen con las reglas federales, estatales y locales.
records.how_to_apply: Start your application online at childcare.twc.texas.gov/find or call Child Care Services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Empiece su solicitud por internet en childcare.twc.texas.gov/find o llame a Servicios de Cuidado Infantil.
records.cost: Parent share of cost based on income
records.notes: Income limits and waitlist status not shown on the page; call to ask. Toll free (800) 457-5633.

records.name: EZ-Rider Bus Reduced Fares
records.description_en: EZ-Rider buses in Midland and Odessa cost $0.60 for seniors, people with disabilities, veterans, and active-duty military, instead of $1.25. Children 5 and under ride free.
records.description_es: Los autobuses EZ-Rider en Midland y Odessa cuestan $0.60 para personas mayores, personas con discapacidad, veteranos y militares activos, en vez de $1.25. Los niños de 5 años o menos viajan gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors 60 and older, people with disabilities, and veterans or active-duty military can get the reduced fare. Youth 6-18 pay $1.00.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Las personas de 60 años o más, las personas con discapacidad y los veteranos o militares activos pueden pagar la tarifa reducida. Los jóvenes de 6 a 18 años pagan $1.00.
records.how_to_apply: Show your Medicare card when you pay to get the senior/disability half fare. Veterans and military, call EZ-Rider to ask what ID to show. Drivers do not carry change.
records.how_to_apply_es: Muestre su tarjeta de Medicare al pagar para recibir la media tarifa para personas mayores o con discapacidad. Si es veterano o militar, llame a EZ-Rider para preguntar qué identificación debe mostrar. Los choferes no dan cambio.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 6:15am-7:10pm; Saturday 8:15am-4:15pm
records.notes: Commuter service between Midland and Odessa uses the same fare levels. All-day pass $3.00. No Sunday service.

records.name: EZ-Rider ADA Paratransit
records.description_en: Curb-to-curb rides in the Midland-Odessa area for people with disabilities who cannot use the regular bus. Certified riders can also ride the regular bus free with their EZ-Rider ID card.
records.description_es: Transporte de acera a acera en el área de Midland-Odessa para personas con discapacidad que no pueden usar el autobús regular. Las personas certificadas también pueden usar el autobús regular gratis con su tarjeta de EZ-Rider.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with disabilities who cannot use regular bus routes, based on ADA rules. You must apply and be certified.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con discapacidad que no pueden usar las rutas regulares del autobús, según las reglas de la ley ADA. Debe aplicar y ser certificado.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the EZ-Rider paratransit application (English or Spanish), have a medical professional verify it, and wait for EZ-Rider to certify you. Call for an application.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de paratránsito de EZ-Rider (en inglés o español), pida que un profesional médico la verifique y espere a que EZ-Rider lo certifique. Llame para pedir la solicitud.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 6:15am-7:10pm; Saturday 8:15am-4:15pm
records.cost: $2.50 per one-way trip within 3/4 mile of a fixed route; $5.00 beyond that
records.notes: No service Sundays or major holidays. Mobility training is available (ext. 116).

records.name: Concho Valley Transit Reduced Fares
records.description_en: San Angelo city buses offer lower fares for seniors, students, military, people with disabilities, and Medicare card holders. Children under 6 ride free with a paying adult.
records.description_es: Los autobuses de la ciudad de San Angelo tienen tarifas más bajas para personas mayores, estudiantes, militares, personas con discapacidad y personas con tarjeta de Medicare. Los niños menores de 6 años viajan gratis con un adulto que paga.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors 65 and older, students, military members, people with a disability, or people with Medicare can get reduced fares with proper ID.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Las personas de 65 años o más, estudiantes, militares, personas con discapacidad o con Medicare pueden pagar tarifa reducida si muestran su identificación.
documents_needed: Proper documentation or ID (senior, student, military, disability, or Medicare card)
records.how_to_apply: Show your ID or documentation when you board.
records.how_to_apply_es: Muestre su identificación o comprobante al subir al autobús.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 6:30 AM-7:30 PM; Saturday 7:30 AM-6:30 PM; Sunday closed
records.notes: Exact fare amounts were not readable on the page. Riders must be 12 or older to ride alone. CVT also runs rural routes across the Concho Valley.

records.name: Concho Valley Transit ADA Para Transit
records.description_en: Shared-ride, curb-to-curb service in wheelchair-accessible vans for people with disabilities. It runs the same days and hours as the city buses.
records.description_es: Servicio compartido de acera a acera en camionetas con acceso para sillas de ruedas, para personas con discapacidad. Funciona los mismos días y horas que los autobuses de la ciudad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with disabilities who qualify through an ADA application. Approval can take up to 21 business days and is not guaranteed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con discapacidad que califican por medio de una solicitud ADA. La aprobación puede tardar hasta 21 días hábiles y no está garantizada.
documents_needed: ADA ParaTransit Application (English or Spanish, official CVT form only)
records.how_to_apply: Call customer service or email cvtd.inquiries@cvcog.org to request the ADA application, or download it from the website, then return it.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a servicio al cliente o escriba a cvtd.inquiries@cvcog.org para pedir la solicitud ADA, o descárguela de la página web, y luego entréguela.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 6:30am-7:30pm, Sat 7:30am-6:30pm (Closed Sundays)
records.notes: Wheelchairs up to 32 inches wide and 800 lbs combined weight. Closed on major holidays. Drivers do not enter buildings.

records.name: CityLink ADA Paratransit
records.description_en: Rides for people in Abilene whose disability keeps them from using the regular city bus.
records.description_es: Transporte para personas en Abilene cuya discapacidad no les permite usar el autobús regular de la ciudad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people whose physical or mental disability prevents them from using the fixed-route bus, based on federal ADA rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas cuya discapacidad física o mental no les permite usar el autobús de ruta fija, según las reglas federales de la ley ADA.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online with the client application and a medical professional questionnaire, visit CityLink at 1189 S 2nd Street (7 a.m. - 6 p.m.), or call (325) 676-6287, Option 2 (weekdays 8 a.m. - 5 p.m.).
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique por internet con la solicitud y el cuestionario de un profesional médico, visite CityLink en 1189 S 2nd Street (7 a.m. a 6 p.m.), o llame al (325) 676-6287, opción 2 (entre semana de 8 a.m. a 5 p.m.).
records.hours: Service: Monday-Friday 6:15 a.m.-5:45 p.m.; Saturday 7:15 a.m.-5:45 p.m. Booking: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: $2.50 one-way in ADA area ($25 for 10 tickets); $3.75 one-way in extended city area ($75 for 20 tickets)
records.notes: No Sunday or holiday service. Exact change required. Email: citylink-ada@abilenetx.gov. Fares may change; confirm by phone.

records.name: Abilene Hope Haven Shelter and Hope Housing
records.description_en: Abilene Hope Haven gives shelter and housing support to people experiencing homelessness and helps them find housing.
records.description_es: Abilene Hope Haven da albergue y apoyo a personas sin hogar y les ayuda a encontrar vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people experiencing homelessness in Abilene.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas sin hogar en Abilene.
records.how_to_apply: Call the shelter to ask about space and intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al albergue para preguntar si hay lugar y cómo es el proceso de entrada.
records.notes: Second phone: (325) 677-4674. Hours and intake rules not listed online.

records.name: Family Promise of Midland Shelter, Eviction Prevention, and Transitional Housing
records.description_en: Family Promise helps families who are homeless or about to lose their housing. It offers shelter, outreach, eviction prevention, transitional housing, job training, tutoring for children, and counseling.
records.description_es: Family Promise ayuda a familias que no tienen hogar o que están por perder su vivienda. Ofrece albergue, visitas de apoyo, ayuda para evitar desalojos, vivienda temporal, capacitación para el trabajo, tutoría para niños y consejería.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families in Midland who are homeless or at risk of eviction.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias en Midland que no tienen hogar o que están en riesgo de desalojo.
records.how_to_apply: Call Family Promise of Midland to ask for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Family Promise of Midland para pedir ayuda.
records.notes: Programs include Families Forward Transitional Housing and Shelter Diversion. Email: fpm@familypromiseofmidland.org.

records.name: Noah Project Domestic Violence Shelter and Services
records.description_en: Noah Project gives free, confidential emergency shelter and support to survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, dating violence, and human trafficking.
records.description_es: Noah Project da albergue de emergencia y apoyo gratis y confidencial a sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, violencia en el noviazgo y trata de personas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people affected by domestic violence, sexual assault, dating violence, or human trafficking in Abilene and nine other West Texas counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas afectadas por violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, violencia en el noviazgo o trata de personas en Abilene y otros nueve condados del oeste de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline for help or shelter.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de 24 horas para pedir apoyo o albergue.
records.notes: Toll-free hotline: 1-800-444-3551. Crisis email: crisishelp@noahproject.org. Serves 10 counties (not all named on the homepage). In immediate danger, call 911.

records.name: The Salvation Army Odessa Corps Social Services
records.description_en: The Salvation Army in Odessa offers help for people in need, including food assistance. Call to ask what help is available now.
records.description_es: El Ejército de Salvación en Odessa ayuda a personas necesitadas, incluso con comida. Llame para preguntar qué ayuda hay ahora.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in Odessa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas necesitadas en Odessa.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Odessa Corps to ask about current services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al Ejército de Salvación de Odessa para preguntar por los servicios de ahora.
records.notes: Food assistance is listed on the page; hours were not listed. Confirm by phone. Thrift store: 505 W. 42nd Street, (432) 362-1866.

records.name: The Salvation Army Midland Corps
records.description_en: The Salvation Army in Midland helps people in need. Call to ask what services are available now.
records.description_es: El Ejército de Salvación en Midland ayuda a personas necesitadas. Llame para preguntar qué servicios hay ahora.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in Midland.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas necesitadas en Midland.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Midland Corps during open hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite el centro de Midland en su horario de atención.
records.hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday: 9:00 AM-12:00 PM; 1:00 PM-3:30 PM (Closed Wednesday)
records.notes: Location, phone, and hours confirmed, but specific services were not listed on the official page; food/housing categories are not confirmed. Call first.

records.name: The Salvation Army Abilene Corps
records.description_en: The Salvation Army in Abilene helps people in need. Call to ask what services are available now.
records.description_es: El Ejército de Salvación en Abilene ayuda a personas necesitadas. Llame para preguntar qué servicios hay ahora.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in Abilene.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas necesitadas en Abilene.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit during open hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite en el horario de atención.
records.hours: Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM-5:00 PM (closed 12:00 PM-1:00 PM); Saturday-Sunday: Closed
records.notes: Location, phone, and hours confirmed, but the official page lists only spiritual/community programs; food/housing help is not confirmed. Call first.

records.name: The Salvation Army San Angelo Lodge (Shelter)
records.description_en: The Salvation Army Lodge in San Angelo offers shelter for people who need a place to stay.
records.description_es: El albergue Lodge del Ejército de Salvación en San Angelo ofrece un lugar donde quedarse a personas que lo necesitan.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in San Angelo who need shelter.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en San Angelo que necesitan albergue.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Lodge to ask about space and intake rules.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al Lodge para preguntar si hay lugar y cuáles son las reglas de entrada.
records.notes: Hours and intake rules not listed online. San Angelo Corps (other services): 34 W 3rd St, San Angelo, TX 76903, (325) 655-6981.

records.name: City of Odessa Rental Assistance and Home Repair Programs
records.description_en: The City of Odessa can pay a landlord directly for short-term rent help. It also has home repair and homebuyer help programs.
records.description_es: La Ciudad de Odessa puede pagarle directamente al dueño de la vivienda para ayudarle con la renta por poco tiempo. También tiene programas para reparar casas y ayudar a comprar casa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For renters in Odessa city limits with income at or below 80% of Area Median Income. You must be a U.S. citizen or long-term legal resident, be named on the lease, mortgage, or utility bill, and your state ID must show your current address. Help is first-come, first-served.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inquilinos dentro de la ciudad de Odessa con ingresos de 80% o menos del ingreso medio del área. Debe ser ciudadano de EE. UU. o residente legal de largo plazo, estar en el contrato de renta, la hipoteca o un recibo de servicios, y su identificación del estado debe tener su dirección actual. La ayuda se da por orden de llegada.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Property must be within Odessa city limits

documents_needed: State ID showing your current address
Lease, mortgage, or utility bill in your name
records.how_to_apply: Register with a valid email address on the city's Neighborly online portal, choose the rental assistance program, and upload your documents.
records.how_to_apply_es: Regístrese con un correo electrónico válido en el portal Neighborly de la ciudad, escoja el programa de ayuda con la renta y suba sus documentos.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
records.notes: Rent is paid directly to the landlord. Applying does not guarantee assistance. Emergency and minor home repair programs are also offered. Email: cd@odessa-tx.gov. Accommodations: (432) 335-4883.

records.name: City of Midland Home Repair and Homebuyer Assistance
records.organization: City of Midland Community Development Office
records.description_en: The City of Midland offers minor home repair grants for homeowners, loans for bigger repairs, and help for first-time home buyers.
records.description_es: La Ciudad de Midland ofrece becas para reparaciones pequeñas a dueños de casa, préstamos para reparaciones más grandes y ayuda para personas que compran casa por primera vez.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Midland homeowners who live in their home (repairs) and people buying a home, mainly in target neighborhoods. Call for income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para dueños de casa en Midland que viven en su casa (reparaciones) y personas que van a comprar casa, sobre todo en ciertos vecindarios. Llame para saber las reglas de ingreso.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Community Development Office to ask about applying.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la Oficina de Desarrollo Comunitario para preguntar cómo aplicar.
records.notes: Mailing address: P.O. Box 1152, Midland, TX 79702. Staff: Program Coordinator (432) 685-7472; Community Development Manager (432) 685-7408. No rental assistance or housing vouchers are listed on the page.

records.name: City of Abilene Neighborhood Services Housing Programs
records.organization: City of Abilene Neighborhood Services Division
records.description_en: The City of Abilene helps first-time home buyers with up to $7,500 for down payment and closing costs, and helps low- to moderate-income homeowners with home rehabilitation and critical repairs.
records.description_es: La Ciudad de Abilene ayuda a quienes compran casa por primera vez con hasta $7,500 para el enganche y los gastos de cierre, y ayuda a dueños de casa de ingresos bajos y moderados con arreglos y reparaciones urgentes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For income-eligible City of Abilene residents. Homebuyers must live, work, or go to school in Abilene and buy inside city limits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de la ciudad de Abilene que califican por ingresos. Quienes compran casa deben vivir, trabajar o estudiar en Abilene y comprar dentro de la ciudad.
records.how_to_apply: Submit a complete application with your documents to Neighborhood Services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Entregue una solicitud completa con sus documentos a Neighborhood Services.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
records.notes: First Time Homebuyer and Single-Family Rehabilitation are accepting applications. Critical Repair applications were set to reopen later in the year; check status.

records.name: City of San Angelo Community and Housing Support
records.organization: City of San Angelo Neighborhood & Family Services
records.description_en: The City of San Angelo helps low- to moderate-income homeowners with repairs and emergency repairs, helps first-time home buyers, and can replace heaters and water heaters for eligible Atmos gas customers.
records.description_es: La Ciudad de San Angelo ayuda a dueños de casa de ingresos bajos a moderados con reparaciones y reparaciones de emergencia, ayuda a quienes compran casa por primera vez y puede cambiar calentones y calentadores de agua a clientes de Atmos que califican.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low- to moderate-income San Angelo residents. Homebuyers must be approved by a participating lender.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de San Angelo de ingresos bajos a moderados. Quienes compran casa deben ser aprobados por un prestamista participante.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Community Development Building to ask about applying.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite el Community Development Building para preguntar cómo aplicar.
records.address: 52 W. College Ave., Community Development Building
records.hours: Monday-Friday: 8 a.m.-noon, 1 p.m.-5 p.m.
records.notes: The city says it no longer has funding to help with rent and utilities. Temporary tenant-based rental assistance under its HOME program is provided through MHMR Concho Valley.

records.name: WIC Clinic (Women, Infants & Children)
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy foods, nutrition education, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC da alimentos saludables, clases de nutrición y apoyo para dar pecho a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant, breastfeeding, and postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 who meet income guidelines.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, que dan pecho o que acaban de dar a luz, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen con los límites de ingreso.
records.how_to_apply: Apply at texaswic.org or call the clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en texaswic.org o llame a la clínica.
records.hours: Monday - Friday 8 am to 6 pm (open during the lunch hour)
records.notes: Email: wic@abilenetx.gov. Lactation consulting available.

records.name: WIC Clinic (Women, Infants & Children)
records.organization: City of San Angelo Neighborhood & Family Services
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy foods, nutrition education, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, and children up to age 5.
records.description_es: WIC da alimentos saludables, clases de nutrición y apoyo para dar pecho a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes y niños hasta los 5 años.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant, postpartum, and breastfeeding women and children up to age five. People on Medicaid, SNAP, or TANF automatically qualify on income; others must meet income guidelines.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, que acaban de dar a luz o que dan pecho, y niños hasta los cinco años. Si recibe Medicaid, SNAP o TANF, califica automáticamente por ingresos; los demás deben cumplir con los límites de ingreso.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the main WIC office in San Angelo.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina principal de WIC en San Angelo.
records.address: 52 W. College Ave., Community Development Building
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 7 a.m. to noon, 1 p.m. to 6 p.m.; first Saturday monthly 8 a.m. to noon by appointment
records.notes: Serves San Angelo-Tom Green County and six surrounding counties, with satellites in Ballinger and Coleman. Breastfeeding support: (325) 655-4347; on-call (325) 234-0875.

records.name: City of Midland Health Services Clinic
records.description_en: The city health department offers immunizations, STD/HIV testing and treatment, and tuberculosis testing.
records.description_es: El departamento de salud de la ciudad ofrece vacunas, pruebas y tratamiento de ETS/VIH y pruebas de tuberculosis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Midland residents who need shots or testing. All services are by appointment.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Midland que necesitan vacunas o pruebas. Todos los servicios son con cita.
records.how_to_apply: Call and press 3 to make an appointment, or request one through the patient portal.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame y marque 3 para hacer una cita, o pídala por el portal de pacientes.
records.hours: Monday - Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
records.notes: Appointment only. Email: MidlandHealth@MidlandTexas.gov.

records.name: Ector County Health Department Clinics
records.description_en: The county health department gives low-cost immunizations, walk-in STD/HIV and TB testing, and free cervical cancer screening for those who qualify.
records.description_es: El departamento de salud del condado da vacunas a bajo costo, pruebas sin cita de ETS/VIH y tuberculosis, y exámenes gratis de cáncer de cuello uterino para quienes califican.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Ector County residents. Pap smear clinic requires qualification.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Ector. Para la clínica de Papanicolau debe calificar.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during TB or STD/HIV clinic times, or call for an immunization or flu shot appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Venga sin cita en el horario de la clínica de TB o de ETS/VIH, o llame para hacer cita para vacunas o la vacuna de la gripe.
records.hours: Closed 12 pm to 1 pm. TB testing Mon & Tue 8:30-11 am and 1-4 pm; STD/HIV Tue 1-3:30 pm, Wed 8:30-10:30 am; Pap clinic Thu 1-3 pm. Immunizations by appointment.
records.cost: Child immunizations $13 (1 shot) or $26 (2+ shots) per child for those who qualify; accepts Medicaid, cash, check, and cards
records.notes: Immunization records are required for everyone under 26. Serves uninsured and underinsured people with prescription assistance programs.

records.name: Mercy Health Care Center
records.description_en: This public health clinic offers prenatal care, family planning, Healthy Texas Women services, PrEP for HIV prevention, and STD testing and treatment.
records.description_es: Esta clínica de salud pública ofrece cuidado prenatal, planificación familiar, servicios de Healthy Texas Women, PrEP para prevenir el VIH, y pruebas y tratamiento de ETS.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Prenatal care is for people who meet financial criteria. Healthy Texas Women is for uninsured women ages 15-44 who are not pregnant, at or below 200% of the poverty level, Texas residents, and U.S. citizens or legal immigrants.
records.eligibility_summary_es: El cuidado prenatal es para personas que cumplen ciertos requisitos económicos. Healthy Texas Women es para mujeres de 15 a 44 años sin seguro médico, que no están embarazadas, con ingresos de 200% o menos del nivel de pobreza, que viven en Texas y son ciudadanas de EE. UU. o inmigrantes legales.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 12:00 pm, 1:00 pm - 5:00 pm
records.cost: STD testing $25; other services based on financial criteria, Medicaid, or self-pay
records.notes: Eligibility rules listed (income, age, uninsured) apply to the Healthy Texas Women program only; STD testing is open to the public.

records.name: Presbyterian Medical Care Mission
records.description_en: This ministry gives primary medical care, low-cost prescriptions, and some specialist care to uninsured, low-income adults in Abilene.
records.description_es: Este ministerio da atención médica general, medicinas a bajo costo y algo de atención con especialistas a adultos sin seguro y de bajos ingresos en Abilene.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income, uninsured adults ages 18-64. People with private insurance, Medicare, or Medicaid do not qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos de 18 a 64 años sin seguro médico y de bajos ingresos. Las personas con seguro privado, Medicare o Medicaid no califican.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to ask about becoming a patient.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para preguntar cómo ser paciente.
records.cost: Free care; prescriptions at a small fee
records.notes: Email: contact@pmcm.org. Hours not listed online.

records.name: Taylor County General Assistance Program
records.description_en: Taylor County helps eligible residents with short-term prescriptions (up to $300), eye exams and glasses, and applying to drug company help programs. A dental program helps with acute dental pain.
records.description_es: El condado de Taylor ayuda a residentes que califican con medicinas por poco tiempo (hasta $300), examen de la vista y lentes, y con solicitudes a programas de ayuda de las compañías de medicinas. Un programa dental ayuda con dolor fuerte de dientes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Taylor County residents who meet income and other rules. Vision care requires income at or below 65% of the poverty level; Medicaid recipients do not qualify for vision care. Dental help is for income at or below 300% of the poverty level.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Taylor que cumplen con las reglas de ingreso y otras reglas. Para la vista, los ingresos deben ser de 65% o menos del nivel de pobreza, y quienes reciben Medicaid no califican. La ayuda dental es para ingresos de 300% o menos del nivel de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply: Download the General Assistance application from the county website or call the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud de Asistencia General en la página web del condado o llame a la oficina.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m., 1:00 p.m.-5:00 p.m.; Friday 8:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m.
records.cost: Free; dental program has a $20 copay
records.notes: Does NOT cover rent or utilities. Acute prescriptions exclude anti-depressants and psychiatric medications. Dental help is through the Christian Service Center.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Midland Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including eviction and housing, family and domestic violence, debt, custody, and wills.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos, como desalojos y vivienda, asuntos de familia y violencia doméstica, deudas, custodia y testamentos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income individuals and families with civil (non-criminal) legal problems.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias de bajos ingresos con problemas legales civiles (no criminales).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the statewide intake line at 1-888-529-5277.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud por internet o llame a la línea de admisión estatal al 1-888-529-5277.
records.notes: Toll free: (800) 926-5630. Intake line: 1-888-529-5277. Income limits not listed on the homepage.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Odessa Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including eviction and housing, family and domestic violence, debt, custody, and wills.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos, como desalojos y vivienda, asuntos de familia y violencia doméstica, deudas, custodia y testamentos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income individuals and families with civil (non-criminal) legal problems.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias de bajos ingresos con problemas legales civiles (no criminales).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the statewide intake line at 1-888-529-5277.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud por internet o llame a la línea de admisión estatal al 1-888-529-5277.
records.notes: Toll free: (800) 955-1207. Intake line: 1-888-529-5277. Income limits not listed on the homepage.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - San Angelo Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including eviction and housing, family and domestic violence, debt, custody, and wills.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos, como desalojos y vivienda, asuntos de familia y violencia doméstica, deudas, custodia y testamentos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income individuals and families with civil (non-criminal) legal problems.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias de bajos ingresos con problemas legales civiles (no criminales).
